# 1 Enoch Chapter 46 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 46:1 — "Head of Days" — rendering the divine title

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "One-who-had-a-Head-of-Days" | Literal description; Ge'ez rē'sa māwāʿel |
| LOGOS | "one who had a Head of Days" | Formal; descriptive |
| PNEUMA | "the One called the Head of Days" | Clarifies it is a title |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "One who had a Head of Days" (LOGOS). The Ge'ez is a description used as a title, translated consistently across the Parables. PNEUMA's "called the Head of Days" over-explains.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 46:1 — "full of graciousness" vs. "full of grace" vs. "radiated grace"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "full of-graciousness" | Literal; Ge'ez ṣəge = grace, favor, beauty |
| LOGOS | "full of grace" | Formal; more natural |
| PNEUMA | "radiated grace" | Vivid but paraphrastic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Full of grace" (LOGOS). "Graciousness" is slightly awkward; "radiated" (PNEUMA) adds a visual metaphor not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 46:3 — "who hath righteousness" vs. "who possesses righteousness"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who-hath-righteousness" | Archaic literal |
| LOGOS | "who possesses righteousness" | Formal modern equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "the one in whom righteousness lives" | Vivid; "lives in" suggests indwelling |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Who possesses righteousness" (LOGOS). Clear and accurate. PNEUMA's "lives in" is attractive but goes slightly beyond the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 46:4 — "loosen the reins of the strong"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "loosen the-reins of-the-strong" | Literal; reins = symbols of power/control |
| LOGOS | "loosen the reins of the strong" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "break the grip of the strong" | "Grip" is a natural English equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Loosen the reins of the strong" (LOGOS). "Reins" is a specific Ge'ez image — the bit and bridle that control — and should be preserved as it differs from "break the teeth" in the same verse.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 46:8 — "hang upon" vs. "cling to" vs. "hold fast to"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who-hang-upon the-name" | Literal; same Ge'ez idiom as 40:5 |
| LOGOS | "who cling to the name" | Interprets as fervent adherence |
| PNEUMA | "who hold fast to the name" | Similar to LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Who cling to the name" (LOGOS). Both LOGOS and PNEUMA are equivalent; "cling" is slightly more vivid. "Hang upon" is too literal and awkward.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 5**
